claim_boundary: Sampled directional-structure screen only; free projection coefficients and the modeled ideal-Gaussian coefficient RD are not measured codec MSE. The rate model is not a universal RD lower bound for non-Gaussian coefficients.

decision.criterion: both panel-leaky and LOO favorable free-oracle s must be below one quarter of required s=0.160964047443681
decision.reason: The deliberately free directional oracle is far short, so the tested procedural subspace-selection mechanism is stopped. This does not exclude a separate non-Gaussian coefficient code.

minimize optimistic source distortion on train-five experts
